parameters.name: InstanceIds
parameters.description: The instance IDs of the cloud services to which the check items belong.

parameters.name: InstanceTypes
parameters.description: The asset types of cloud services.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

*   **zh**: Chinese
*   **en**: English

parameters.name: Vendors
parameters.description:
The cloud service providers. Valid values:

*   **ALIYUN**: Alibaba Cloud.
*   **TENCENT**: Tencent Cloud.
*   **HUAWEICLOUD**: Huawei Cloud.
*   **MICROSOFT**: Microsoft Azure.
*   **AWS**: Amazon Web Services (AWS).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas list-check-standard --vendors ALIYUN --instance-types ECS --instance-sub-types INSTANCE --instance-ids i-000 --lang zh --task-sources YAO_CHI --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas ListCheckStandard --region cn-hangzhou --TaskSources.1 YAO_CHI --InstanceSubTypes.1 INSTANCE --Vendors.1 ALIYUN --Lang zh --InstanceTypes.1 ECS --InstanceIds.1 'i-000'
